question: Estimate the per-flight crew cost for an international long-haul flight (e.g., Mumbai-London on Air India).
idealClarificationQuestions: Single Mumbai-London 9-hour flight, B777 / B787 (Air India)? Yes.
Total crew cost (pilots + cabin) per flight? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Cabin crew (avg ₹8-12 lakh/yr fully loaded; ~₹2K/hr): 13 × 9 × ₹2K = ₹2.3 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round trip with rest period: ~₹38-45 lakh.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 4 (2 captain + 2 first officer; double crew for >9 hour flight).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total crew cost per one-way long-haul flight

calculationFlow: - Pilots: 4 (2 captain + 2 first officer; double crew for >9 hour flight).
- Cabin crew: ~13 (1 senior + 12 others for 300+ seat 777).
- Captain hourly cost (avg salary ₹4 cr/year, 600 flight hrs/yr = ~₹65K/hr): 2 × 9 × ₹65K = ₹11.7 lakh.
- Cabin crew (avg ₹8-12 lakh/yr fully loaded; ~₹2K/hr): 13 × 9 × ₹2K = ₹2.3 lakh.
- Plus allowances (overseas layover, per diem): ~₹2 lakh.
Total crew cost per one-way long-haul flight: ~₹22 lakh.
Round trip with rest period: ~₹38-45 lakh.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Round trip with rest period: ~₹38-45 lakh.
